chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: How he got the name Erskine Ramsey Hawkins
summary: His birth certificate said Johnny Hawkins and he changed it.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And, you don't know how I got my name. My mother was working at this school in Birmingham called Erskine Ramsey High. And, my mother and the president, you know, the president liked my mother very much. She was back there in the kitchen, making, cooking, you know, things like that.
So, my original name was Johnny Hawkins

And so, the president, you know, on my birth certificate, which I didn't know. Nobody knew until I got ready to go across the sea. I had to get my brith certificate. I looked on there and saw Johnny Hawkins. My cousin got it for me in Birmingham.
And, my mother never changed it when she changed it (inaudible), Erskine Ramsey Hawkins. You know? And then I had it changed.
You don't feel like a Johnny, huh?
No. Johnny, Johnny. I'm trying to think if there was a middle name in there. I don't remember.

Yeah. So, I never did get a chance to meet the first Erskine Ramsey cause I was, you know, a child, a baby. So, when I was on my way to New York, my mother was still working there. When I go to New York, I had her to stop. Stay home. I said you did enough. See, my father passed when I was 7 years old. So, when I got to New York, I had her, said you stay home. So, she didn't work no more.
So, I took care of everything there so she could relax the rest of her life before she passed on.
